name: io.github.raydeoliveira/flightmortem
title: FlightMortem for ArduPilot, PX4 and Betaflight flight logs
description: Free log inspection, power, FFT and crash analysis. Metered tuning diffs and flight comparisons.

headers.name: X-Polar-License-Key
headers.description: Optional Polar license key for tuning diffs and before/after flight comparisons.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer API key or Payment receipt header for per-call metered tool access.

headers.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
headers.description: Optional x402 v2 Base64 payment payload header for per-call USDC settlement.
